anonymous-definition.notes: Workflows only. zizmor also checks action.yml, which jactionlint does not lint.

concurrency-limits.notes: Reports a missing concurrency block and cancel-in-progress left unset or false. Skips workflows started only by workflow_call and workflows where every job has its own concurrency.

dangerous-triggers.notes: pull_request_target, workflow_run and issue_comment (zizmor 1.30.1 does not flag issue_comment yet). jactionlint reports at the trigger and zizmor at on:, so lines differ for multi-line on blocks.

insecure-commands.notes: Workflow, job and step env, when the value is true. action.yml and container env are not checked.

overprovisioned-secrets.notes: The whole secrets context (toJSON(secrets), secrets[...], a bare secrets).

secrets-inherit.notes: Reports secrets: inherit at the calling job.

secrets-outside-env.notes: Jobs with secrets but no environment. The allow option mirrors zizmor's.

self-hosted-runner.notes: Literal labels and matrix values. Labels that come from other expressions are not resolved.

typosquat-uses.notes: Slugs one edit away from a popular action of another owner. zizmor's typomania covers more transformations.

unredacted-secrets.notes: Any fromJSON(secrets.X), with or without a field access.

unsound-contains.notes: contains() with a string literal as its first argument in if: conditions.

template-injection.notes: jactionlint reports untrusted contexts in expressions. zizmor also covers env indirection, github-script and more contexts.

hardcoded-container-credentials.notes: The hardcoded-container-credentials rule reports a literal password in container or services credentials.

excessive-permissions.notes: Only the opt-in missing-permissions check (no permissions block at all). Broad write scopes are not reported yet.

unpinned-uses.notes: Only the opt-in unpinned-uses check (require-commit-hash in v1), for actions and for reusable workflows.

must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA

unpinned-images.notes: Only docker:// action references under unpinned-uses. container: and services: images are not checked yet.

docker image must be pinned to a digest

unsound-ternary.notes: jactionlint reports the falsy ternary idiom. zizmor 1.30.1 has no audit of this name, so this entry stays inert until a matching audit exists.

forbidden-uses.notes: allow and deny lists of repository patterns (rules.forbidden-uses.allow and deny); not measured against zizmor yet. required-actions is the separate inverse check and does not cover these findings.
